research_question: Does the focal-relative path primitive exhibit stable measurement behavior across multiple professional matches from an independent tracking dataset?

construct.name: focal departure from collective defensive motion
construct.definition: focal defender position minus the contemporaneous centroid of the other available defending outfield players
construct.primary_outcome: accumulated Euclidean path of smoothed focal-relative x/y coordinates in metres

sampling.grid: smallest elapsed-match multiple of interval length not before tracking begins in each period

smoothing.method: centered rolling arithmetic mean applied separately to x and y within interval

usable_match_all_required: faithful outcome-blind provider mapping with no unresolved interval/reference issue
at least 40 eligible intervals for each defending team
at least 8 focal defenders with at least 25 eligible intervals

activity.relationship: per-match Spearman with interval-cluster bootstrap uncertainty

common_translation.translation: one observed valid collective trajectory applied identically to fixed relative defender positions

temporally_misaligned_reference.collective_activity_bins: stable rank full-centroid path ascending; ties period,start,interval_id; zero-based rank r assigned min(2,floor(3*r/N))

uncertainty.role: estimate uncertainty; does not replace match-level directional criteria

activity_reversal.isolated: one variable in one match; report and match is non-core; does not alone preclude A
repeated_or_concentrated_precludes_A: 2 or more variables reversed within 1 match
behavioral_failure_C: same variable reversed in at least 3 usable matches
at least 2 variables reversed within each of at least 2 usable matches

primary_setting_must_pass: none of four activity relationships rho <= -0.10
setting_consistent_all: none of four activity relationships rho <= -0.10

precedence: if fewer than 5 usable matches classify P
else if any C rule holds classify C
else if every A rule holds classify A

B_mixed_partial.definition: P and C excluded, but at least one A rule is not met
examples: 4 or 5 core matches, or 6 core matches with another non-C A failure
isolated or repeated activity reversals below C frequency

C_behavioral_failure_any_with_at_least_5: same activity variable rho <= -0.10 in at least 3 usable matches
at least 2 activity variables rho <= -0.10 within each of at least 2 usable matches
at least 3 usable matches materially contradict misaligned control
at least 3 usable matches fail frozen sensitivity rule

reasons: unresolved provider mapping or construct-equivalence issue
identity, coordinate, goalkeeper, substitution, ball, possession, event, or missingness limitation

implementation_resolution.stage: after data access but before focal-relative outcome construction

numeric_boundary_purposes.8_focal_defenders_with_25_intervals: prevent a very small defender subset from carrying a match
numeric_boundary_purposes.70_percent_misaligned_support: require the reference control to apply broadly
numeric_boundary_purposes.strict_positive_median_and_majority: require directional worsening under the inappropriate reference without an effect-size target
numeric_boundary_purposes.rho_at_or_below_minus_0_10: distinguish material reversal from weak or near-null deviation
numeric_boundary_purposes.5_seconds_7_frames_and_4_5_6_by_5_7_9: transfer established measurement scales and test limited robustness without optimization
numeric_boundary_purposes.8_of_9_sensitivity_settings: allow one support-edge result but no material directional reversal
numeric_boundary_purposes.6_of_7_strong_replication: require replication in all but one target match
numeric_boundary_purposes.3_match_failure_boundaries: represent repeated failure across nearly half the target dataset
numeric_boundary_purposes.1e-8_metres: identify numerical zero or calculation failure rather than a football effect size

prohibited: IDSSE outcome inspection before protocol freeze
